name: Crown Scorpion
description: A crypt scorpion that wears a ring of grave gold across its head. Its heavy pincers hold a target steady for the crowned tail.

abilities.description: Starts combat with 4 block. Absorbed damage spends it permanently for this fight.
Applies 3 poison once per response only if a strike damages player health.
